notes: UI-free Playnite.Core.Metadata.MetadataService over an injectable IMetadataProvider with a provider-independent document (description, links, artwork references), a bounded atomic cache keyed by provider identity plus app id, and ordered per-game results. Cache entries are schema-validated JSON written through a sibling temporary file and rename, bounded by entry count and bytes, and evicted least-recently-used after a hit refreshes recency; MaxAge distinguishes fresh, stale and offline hits from misses. An online provider failure serves a validated stale entry as Stale with the provider reason, a miss is Failed, and offline never calls the provider and reports offline-cache-miss/corrupt/unreadable; no value is fabricated. A batch continues after a per-game failure and caller cancellation propagates. Tests use a local fake provider and a manual clock with no network or UI. Provider seam only: the Steam JSON provider is deferred until the frozen spec's remote-endpoint evidence exists.
